articles.title: 750 Teens Jump Into Dirt Pits — And It's a National Championship!
articles.summary: About 750 high schoolers traveled to Oklahoma to judge dirt—really! At the National Land and Range Judging Contest, they tested soil to see if it's good for crops or building. One freshman drove 15 hours from Kentucky just to play in the mud.

articles.title: Mbappe's France Faces Morocco in a World Cup Rematch Full of History
articles.summary: France and Morocco clash in the World Cup quarterfinals on Thursday at Foxborough Stadium. It's a rematch of the 2022 semifinal, which France won 2-0. Star Kylian Mbappe has already scored 7 goals, but Morocco is no longer a surprise team—they're serious contenders.

articles.title: The Fight Over Food for Peace: Feeding the Hungry or Helping Farmers?
articles.summary: The U.S. 'Food for Peace' program was shut down, then revived under the Department of Agriculture. Now, lawmakers are debating who should run it. Critics say USDA focuses too much on helping American farmers instead of starving people. The program has fed 4 billion people since the 1950s.
